text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ

translations.asad: BEHOLD. We sent Noah unto his people. [saying:] "Warn thy people ere grievous suffering befall them!
translations.sahih: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."

text.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ

translations.asad: [And Noah] said: "O my people! I am but a plain warner to you, [sent to tell you]
translations.sahih: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,

text.arabic: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ

translations.asad: that you should worship God [alone] and be conscious of Him. "Now do pay heed unto me,
translations.sahih: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.

text.arabic: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.asad: so that He may forgive you some of your sins, and grant you respite until a term known [to Him alone]: but, behold, when the term appointed by God does come, it can never be put back - if you but knew it!"
translations.sahih: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "

text.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا

translations.asad: [And after a time, Noah] said: "O my Sustainer! Verily, I have been calling unto my people night and day
translations.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.

text.arabic: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًۭا

translations.asad: but my call has only caused them to flee farther and farther away [from Thee].
translations.sahih: But my invitation increased them not except in flight.

text.arabic: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا

translations.asad: And behold, whenever I called unto them with a view to Thy granting them forgiveness, they put their fingers into their ears, and wrapped themselves up in their garments [of sin]; and grew obstinate, and became [yet more] arrogant in their false pride.
translations.sahih: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.

text.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًۭا

translations.asad: "And behold I called unto them openly;
translations.sahih: Then I invited them publicly.

text.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًۭا

translations.asad: and, behold I preached to them in public; and I spoke to them secretly, in private;
translations.sahih: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

text.arabic: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا

translations.asad: and I said: "'Ask your Sustainer to forgive you your sins - for, verily, He is all-forgiving!
translations.sahih: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

text.arabic: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًۭا

translations.asad: He will shower upon you heavenly blessings abundant,
translations.sahih: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

text.arabic: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًۭا

translations.asad: and will aid you with worldly goods and children, and will bestow upon you gardens, and bestow upon you running waters.
translations.sahih: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.

text.arabic: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًۭا

translations.asad: "'What is amiss with you that you cannot look forward to God's majesty,
translations.sahih: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur

text.arabic: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا

translations.asad: seeing that He has created [every one of] you in successive stages?
translations.sahih: While He has created you in stages?

text.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا

translations.asad: "'Do you not see how God has created seven heavens in full harmony with one another,
translations.sahih: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers

text.arabic: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًۭا

translations.asad: and has set up within them the moon as a light [reflected] and set up the sun as a [radiant] lamp?
translations.sahih: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?

text.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًۭا

translations.asad: "'And God has caused you to grow out of the earth in [gradual] growth; and thereafter He will return you to it [in death]:
translations.sahih: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.

text.arabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًۭا

translations.asad: and [then] He will bring you forth [from It] in resurrection.
translations.sahih: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

text.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًۭا

translations.asad: "'And God has made the earth a wide expanse for you,
translations.sahih: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse

text.arabic: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًۭا فِجَاجًۭا

translations.asad: so that you might walk thereon on spacious paths.’"
translations.sahih: That you may follow therein roads of passage.' "

text.arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا

translations.asad: [And] Noah continued: "O my Sustainer! Behold, they have opposed me [throughout], for they follow people whose wealth and children lead them increasingly into ruin,
translations.sahih: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.

text.arabic: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًۭا كُبَّارًۭا

translations.asad: and who have devised a most awesome blasphemy [against Thee],
translations.sahih: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.

text.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّۭا وَلَا سُوَاعًۭا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًۭا

translations.asad: inasmuch as they said [to their followers], 'Do not ever abandon your gods: abandon neither Wadd nor Suwa', and neither Yaghuth nor Ya’uq nor Nasr!'
translations.sahih: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.

text.arabic: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلًۭا

translations.asad: "And so they have led many a one astray: hence, ordain Thou that these evildoers stray but farther and farther away [from all that they may desire]!"
translations.sahih: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."

text.arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا

translations.asad: And so, because of their sins, they were drowned [in the great flood], and were doomed to suffer the fire [of the hereafter]; and they found none who could succour them against God.
translations.sahih: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.

text.arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا

translations.asad: And Noah prayed: "O my Sustainer! Leave not on earth any of those who deny the truth:
translations.sahih: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.

text.arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًۭا كَفَّارًۭا

translations.asad: for, behold, If Thou dost leave them, they will [always try to] lead astray those who worship Thee, and will give birth to nothing but wickedness and stubborn ingratitude.
translations.sahih: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.

text.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًۭا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا

translations.asad: "O my Sustainer! Grant Thy forgiveness unto me and unto my parents, and unto everyone who enters my house as a believer, and unto all believing men and believing women [of later times]; and grant Thou that the doers of evil shall increasingly meet with destruction!"'
translations.sahih: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
